drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel: Attached is our proposed revision, subject to client approval. We propose 18 months’ base salary and continued benefits for termination without cause or resignation for defined Good Reason, with express payment deadlines and no discretionary approval or release condition. We have deleted the non-compete. The benefits proposal is set out in the draft; the Base Salary figure remains open pending client instructions.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual Base Salary of [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED], payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll schedule, but no less frequently than monthly. The Executive shall be eligible for medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, retirement plan participation, and paid time off on terms no less favorable than those applicable to similarly situated senior executives, subject to applicable plan terms and law. The Company shall reimburse reasonable business expenses upon submission of customary supporting documentation.
edits.name: Compensation and benefits

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall pay severance equal to 18 months of Base Salary at the rate immediately before termination or, if greater, immediately before any reduction giving rise to Good Reason. Severance shall be paid in a lump sum within 30 days after termination, subject to legally required withholding. For 18 months after termination, the Company shall continue the Executive’s and eligible dependents’ medical, dental and vision coverage, and the Executive’s life and disability coverage, on the same cost-sharing basis as immediately before termination. If continued participation is unavailable under applicable law or plan terms, the Company shall arrange equivalent coverage or pay monthly cash amounts sufficient to purchase equivalent coverage, with payments due on the first business day of each month of that period. These obligations are not conditioned on a release, discretionary approval, mitigation, or compliance with any post-employment non-compete, and shall not be reduced by earnings from other employment. Accrued salary, vested benefits and reimbursable expenses are payable separately in accordance with applicable law and plan terms. 'Cause' means fraud or embezzlement against the Company, conviction of or a plea of guilty or no contest to a felony involving dishonesty, or willful material misconduct causing material harm to the Company. For misconduct capable of cure, Cause requires written notice specifying the conduct and 30 days to cure. 'Good Reason' means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in Base Salary, a material diminution in duties or authority, relocation of the principal workplace by more than 50 miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. The Executive must give written notice within 90 days after learning of the condition, allow the Company 30 days to cure, and resign within 60 days after that cure period expires if the condition remains uncured. Payments shall be structured to qualify for exemptions from Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code to the maximum extent available. Only to the extent legally required under Section 409A, a payment shall be delayed until the first business day following six months after separation from service, or earlier death, with all delayed amounts paid together on that date.
edits.name: Severance and defined termination events

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. Deleted. This Agreement imposes no post-employment non-compete restriction.
edits.name: Delete non-compete
